query: s41467-026-76382-x correction retraction update; NCT02555358 update; independent follow-up
content: The morning search found the September 4 Nature Communications article still presented as the version of record with no correction or retraction notice. ClinicalTrials.gov still reports NCT02555358 completed, last update posted 19 October 2023, with no posted results on that registry page. No independent replication or later clinical-use evidence was found. The reviewed article's bounded distinction between prediction performance and improved patient outcomes therefore remains necessary and unchanged.
